newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka rupee closes unmoved in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka rupee closes unmoved in thin trade.

text.p: The Sri Lanka rupee closed unmoved in thin trade on Wednesday on absence of commercial demand, dealers said.
The rupee closed at its opening level of 57.65 to the dollar after crawling in a tight range, they said.
"There was no commercial demand for dollars and speculators were unable to take it beyond 57.80, at which level there is selling waiting to come out," said a Union Bank dealer.
Overnight call money rates closed at 11 percent after rising to a high of 12 during the day, dealers said.
"Despite low call money, banks are not keen to build dollar positions due to the high cost of carrying dollars," said a Deutsche Bank dealer.
